scenario: Regex on Bytes rejection per LSTR.7.1.1. Regex patterns operate on `String` at the codepoint level; applying a regex to a `Bytes` value is a compile error. The author must `decode` first. Pin: `r.raw ~ /^abc/` on a `Bytes` slot rejects with DS_VALIDATE_REGEX_ON_BYTES.
rules_ds:
schema Raw scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    raw: Bytes mutable

rule trig:
    Raw r where r.raw ~ /^abc/
->
    log info "x"
